overview_description.description: The Context Company analyzes AI agent conversations and traces to surface user patterns, performance trends, and moments where agents struggle. It turns production interactions into structured signals with topic clustering, feedback analysis, custom pattern tracking, alerts, traces, tool calls, latency, and costs.
